notes: All settings are frozen from xjtu_gru_predictive_v1 except the random seed.
The first seed is rerun to check deterministic reproduction of the previous single-seed experiment.
Training uses Bearing1_1-Bearing1_3; Bearing1_4 selects checkpoints; Bearing1_5 is an already-inspected old holdout.
Normalized lifetime is used only for descriptive evaluation.
This is a three-seed exploratory stability study, not a blind validation.
